blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns. Today we talk about yesterday's tax meeting at Czarnikow.

The meeting was in a small room. Sophie was there. The tax numbers were on the table, and the result was good. Everybody was happy.

Taxes are just one more part of the company's routine. Sophie explains the tax words slowly, in simple English. One small step at a time — you can do it!

items.q: Where was the meeting?
items.why: "The meeting was in a small room."

items.q: How was the result?
items.why: "the result was good."

items.q: When was the meeting?
items.why: O texto fala de "yesterday's tax meeting" — a reunião foi ontem.

items.q: The text suggests that Sophie is…
items.why: Inferência: "Sophie explains the tax words slowly, in simple English" — ela ajuda com calma.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: English about taxes can be simple
items.why: Inferência: "Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie contar a reunião de ontem para um colega que faltou. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! You were not at the tax meeting yesterday, so let me tell you about it.

The meeting was in room two, next to the coffee machine. It was short — only thirty minutes. Marta and I were there, and Peter was there too. The room was small, but it was fine for three people.

The numbers were ready on the table. The result was good — very good, actually. Last month the numbers were not clear, and we were a little worried. But yesterday they were correct, so we were all happy.

Peter was a little late, but that was okay. He was busy with another form. The tax form was on the table, the numbers were right, and we were fast this time. No problems.

So, don't worry. Everything was fine. The result is on my desk now. When you have time, come to my room and we go over it together. It is easy — one small step at a time. See you soon!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where was the meeting?
items.why: "The meeting was in room two, next to the coffee machine."

items.q: Who was a little late?
items.why: "Peter was a little late, but that was okay."

items.q: How were the numbers last month?
items.why: "Last month the numbers were not clear, but yesterday they were correct."

items.q: Sophie's message suggests that she is…
items.why: Inferência: "don't worry", "It is easy", "See you soon" — o tom é calmo e amigável.

items.q: Why does Sophie say "one small step at a time"?
options: To make the colleague feel it is easy
To tell the colleague the work is late
items.why: Inferência: ela quer que o colega fique tranquilo — passo a passo é fácil.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The tax meeting starts at ten." A meeting is…
options: a time when people come together to talk
items.why: Meeting = reunião: quando as pessoas se juntam para conversar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We were in the small ___ next to the coffee machine."
items.why: Room = sala; é o lugar onde a reunião aconteceu.

items.q: "Please check this number on the form." A number is…
items.why: Number = número: uma cifra, como 10 ou 250.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ was good, so everybody was happy."
items.why: Result = resultado: o que a reunião mostrou no fim.

items.q: "The meeting was yesterday." Yesterday means…
items.why: Yesterday = ontem: o dia antes de hoje.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com impostos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill in the tax form." To fill in means to…
options: write the information in the blanks
items.why: Fill in = preencher: escrever as informações nos espaços.

items.q: "Can you hand in the report today?" To hand in means to…
options: give it to the person in charge
items.why: Hand in = entregar: dar o documento para quem pediu.

items.q: "Let's go over the numbers together." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar: olhar com atenção, ponto a ponto.

items.q: "Please write down the result." To write down means to…
items.why: Write down = anotar: registrar no papel.

items.q: "The boss must sign off on the form." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.
